title: Made and released my first game using Claude Code
author: horrible_hobbit
selftext:
Started messing around with Claude Code a few weeks ago to see what it could do with game development. 

It's called Midnight Pet Hotel. Basically a cozy management game where you run a hotel for animals. Starts small, but over 25 nights you expand, hire staff, deal with increasingly demanding guests, and try to keep the place running.

Claude did pretty much all the coding. I handled the ideas, tested builds, found bugs, and gave feedback on what worked and what didn't. There was a LOT of back and forth.

Toward the end I got tired of micromanaging every change, so I basically told Claude to take over and finish the game however it thought best. Funny enough, instead of adding a bunch of stuff, it mostly cleaned up what was already there.

It's not perfect, and I'm sure people will find things I missed, but I'm pretty happy with how it turned out.

[https://darnaku.itch.io/midnight-pet-hotel](https://darnaku.itch.io/midnight-pet-hotel) 

Got a Windows, and Linux demo.

Also I've been messing around with blender, and aseprite is it worth creating assets or just buying them? Maybe it's my prompts, or high expectations , I'm just getting good results. Or is this a case of have Claude make the prompt that will be used to prompt it?
